text:
maya: Hey team — PR #16123 has been showing an intermittent failure in integration/kvs-multi on pool-2 since last night. It passes locally and in other pools. Can someone with approval rights trigger a targeted rerun for the failing shards? :slightly_frowning_face:
ryan: Which shards are failing? any logs? :eyes:
maya: Failing tests are: test_kv_expiry and test_kv_compaction. Logs show a timeout in the client handshake only on pool-2, stack snippet below:
```
E        ConnectionError: handshake timed out after 10.1s
  File "/runners/tests/test_kv.py", line 132, in test_kv_expiry
    assert client.set(key, value)
```
maya: The snapshot diffs look unrelated (small timestamp drift) so I don't think we need a snapshot update. This looks like infra flakiness or scheduling skew.
sasha: If it's infra, a targeted rerun on the 2 failing shards is fine. I can kick it if someone with perms approves the rerun in Buildkite.
courtney: I'm around — happy to approve. ping me the rerun command or the Buildkite link. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks! Buildkite link: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/16123#build-4567 and failing shards are 3 and 7. Command for targeted rerun from CLI:
```
bk agent build -b 4567 --rebuild-shards 3,7
```
ryan: Quick thought — add a tiny retry in the test for the handshake to see if it's truly transient? But that might mask a real issue. I'd prefer rerun first.
sasha: Agreed. I'll wait for approval then kick the rerun. @courtney can you :+1:?
courtney: +1, go ahead.
sasha: Kicking targeted rebuild now.
ci-bot: build 4567 (shards 3,7) queued by sasha. ETA ~7m. :signal_strength:
maya: Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll watch the new run and post results. If it recurs we'll open an infra ticket and capture more traces.
ryan: If it flakes again, let's capture tcpdump from pool-2 node and the scheduler logs. Might be network hiccup.
maya: Will do. Posting back in ~10m. :coffee:
